**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, GOVLAW)**

- **Governing law — acceptable.** § 14.3 selects New York substantive law, which is our preferred jurisdiction. No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the Agreement, and no foreign venue is imposed, so the walk-away scenario is not present.
- **Gap — no forum/venue.** The clause stops at choice of law. The only jurisdiction references elsewhere are incidental ("court of competent jurisdiction" in §§ 8.2 and 14.5), and § 14.19 addresses only geographic scope of delivery, not forum. IBM could therefore attempt to sue in any forum despite New York law applying.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level).** Added one sentence to § 14.3 submitting the parties to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, leaving the existing choice-of-law wording untouched.
